title: current_user.can Rider 1, residue 2: the row-menu and data-table row-action disabled legs still fail OPEN while the permissions payload loads, and the ActionProvider runner answers current_user only on some pages (objectui#4421)
body:
This card carries the Rider 1 residue that objectui#11212 left on the `disabled` legs and the runner bag; objectui#11212 kept the `visible` legs and the `page:header` `disabled` leg (PR objectui#11237), and the parent objectui#4421 closes when this card lands.

Filing-gate category: ① a derived in-scope item of an in-flight card (the parent's acceptance needs it), filed by the claiming seat `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`), which inherits objectui#4421's `domain:ui` and `priority:p2`.
Dedup: none needed for a derived sub-item; the parent's and objectui#11212's threads are the record.

## The ruling it completes

objectui#4421 Rider 1 (`5321072032`), verbatim: "**Rider 1 — fail direction**: permission-shaped bindings are **fail-closed while the permissions payload has not loaded** — the opposite of the predicate default — or the first-paint leak reappears. Pin this." For a `disabled` gate, fail-closed means DISABLED; PR objectui#11237 applied that to `page:header` and the at-tier review `5915761337` confirmed the direction matches the rest of the `useCondition` family.

## Item 1 — two authored-action `disabled` legs still fail open (the objectui#11212 dev's `open_questions[0]`, answered A by this seat)

- **Measured** under jsdom with the production `RowActionMenu`, the real `ExpressionProvider` and `MePermissionsProvider`: a row-menu item with `disabled: !current_user.can('account', 'delete')` reads ENABLED / enabled / disabled (not loaded / granted / denied). Its own comment says "disabled fails soft (not disabled)".
- **Same code shape, not measured:** the data-table row action's `disabled` (`fallback: false` through `evalRowPredicate`).
- `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` tells authors the row menu evaluates the same predicate as the header, so one declaration now reads DISABLED on the header and ENABLED on the row menu while the payload loads.
- **Direction (A):** flip those two authored-action `disabled` legs to fail closed (fallback `true`), as the header now does. ⛔ The built-in `disabledWhen` (`RecordDetailView` / `DetailView` / `ObjectView` / `ObjectDataPage`) stays fail-soft: its posture is documented and pinned (PR objectui#4515), and the built-in Edit / Delete are already permission-gated by the affordance rules. That was option B, not taken.

## Item 2 — the provider runner answers `current_user` only on some pages (the objectui#11237 review, ③)

- PR objectui#11237 binds the predicate-scope subject as `current_user` in `useActionEngine`, which writes it onto the shared `ActionProvider` runner. So on a page that mounts `record:quick_actions`, `record:alert` or a dashboard block, every `execute` gate (a header action's `disabled` re-check, `params[].visible`) answers `current_user`; on a page without one, it still faults. That is a page-shaped fault where there used to be a uniform one.
- **Direction:** bind the subject at `ActionProvider` itself (same package; it can read `usePredicateScope()`), so the two paths are one bag on every page, the objectui#6493 "one bag" rule. Also correct `ActionRunner.execute`'s `disabled`-gate comment, which says a fault "defaults to NOT-disabled" while the code blocks (the code is right).
- Noted by the review, for the same change's docs: on the runner bag `user.can(…)` still faults while `current_user.can(…)` answers.

Reach for both items: the not-loaded state renders only outside `MePermissionsProvider` (`/forms/:name`, standalone embeds), as for objectui#11212.

Dedupe words: `row menu disabled current_user.can` · `RowActionMenuItem disabled fail-soft` · `Rider 1 disabled legs` · `ActionProvider current_user runner page-shaped`
